product_category.value: VR simulation and immersive learning software suite for training emergency services and other safety-critical professionals (fire and rescue, police and security, ambulance, aviation, transport and energy)

evidence.quote: Train smarter with advanced VR simulation software designed for safety and emergency response teams.
XVR combines simulation, immersive learning, and investigation tools in a single, complementary software suite.

product_category.note: Products in the menu: XVR On Scene, RiVR Link, RiVR Fire Investigation & CSI, XVR Expo. Only XVR On Scene has a saved page. The first quote is the homepage META DESCRIPTION.

evidence.quote: Enhance the competence and expertise of your staff with our flexible and immersive VR learning and training solutions.
Uses VR head‑mounted displays for team‑based reconnaissance and hazard assessment

platforms.note: The head-mounted display quote describes one customer (Safety Region Drenthe). The XVR On Scene page describes a 'virtual simulation environment' with classroom-based and 'Remote and distributed training' on 'a secure network', but does not say whether learners use headsets, desktop computers or a browser, so Desktop and Web are not listed. The What is VR Training page distinguishes 'passive' and 'active' VR.

The home page mentions LearnPro Group's related platforms (ERP, e-learning creation, competency tracking) as separate products.

value_proposition.value: Safe, repeatable virtual experience of complex, high-risk, low-frequency incidents, so responders practise decision-making and learn from consequences before such incidents happen, with the instructor in control.

evidence.quote: XVR On Scene provides a virtual training environment in which emergency responders and other frontline staff can experience complex situations, practise decision‑making, and learn from the consequences – while the instructor remains in control.
Discover how high-fidelity training prepares responders for high-risk, low-frequency events in a safe, realistic, and controlled environment.

value_proposition.note: The What is VR Training page also lists cost and resource benefits ('Reduce reliance on physical training environments, resources, and travel.').

evidence.quote: Virtual Training. Real Experience.
Virtual training – real experience.

tagline.note: Homepage first headline after the menu; the same words recur on the XVR On Scene page with different punctuation and case. Not marked as a trademark. Other candidates: 'Experience it before it happens.' (home); page title 'Training Software For Emergency Services'.

pricing.note: No prices, plans or quote/pricing buttons on the pages read. Calls to action are 'Request a Demo', 'Contact Us' and a literature download form. The What is VR Training page lists 'Cost‑Effective and Resource‑Efficient' as a benefit without figures.
